## File: facebookresearch_belebele/assemble_training_set.py

Prompts

```
['run the script to download and assemble multiple reading comprehension datasets into a unified TSV training set', 'download and extract dataset archives from URLs into a local directory with support for zip and tar.gz', 'process SciQ JSON files into a normalized DataFrame with shuffled answers and sentence count filtering', 'process MultiRC JSON files into a normalized DataFrame filtering for single-answer questions with four or more options', 'process MCScript XML files into a normalized DataFrame by extracting passages and questions from XML nodes']
```

Usage

```
{'run_assemble_training_set': 'run the script to download and assemble multiple reading comprehension datasets into a unified TSV training set', 'download_files': 'download and extract dataset archives from URLs into a local directory with support for zip and tar.gz', 'process_sciq': 'process SciQ JSON files into a normalized DataFrame with shuffled answers and sentence count filtering', 'process_multirc': 'process MultiRC JSON files into a normalized DataFrame filtering for single-answer questions with four or more options', 'process_mcscript': 'process MCScript XML files into a normalized DataFrame by extracting passages and questions from XML nodes'}
```
